q1_issues.issue: sk_weeks_1 is minted as a referent for "those two weeks" but never given a class atom, so an untyped referent symbol appears in the output and then fills slots at 39, 46 and 57.
The Time role is filled with an entity witness (sk_weeks_1 here and at 46; sk_autumn_1/sk_autumn_2 at 21 and 68) rather than a structured calendar term or a named/deictic time constant.
(During sk_collect_1 sk_weeks_1) nests the collecting inside something that is not a reified eventuality, while During is specified as relating two reified eventualities.
The three past-perfect clauses (had been visible / had hunted / had molted) emit Past but no Before ordering, although the passage supplies the day-60 visibility event for them to precede.

q2_gaps: Approximated cardinal count ("about four sky-cats", "about ten", "about twelve feathers", "about thirty-five"): Cardinality takes a native integer, ParticleFromNormal is defined only for Measure/Time magnitudes, and CardinalityPhrase is defined for vague quantities with no exact number normalized to a canonical lexicon string.

Normalcy-baseline framing ("In a normal autumn about ten sky-cats are visible ...") — a typical/expected value under normal conditions; there is no typicality operator, and the indefinite-witness route asserts one particular autumn.

Anaphoric multi-unit time-span NP ("in those two weeks", "during those two weeks"): term propagation is specified for single day-level or coarser calendar terms, not for a stated N-unit interval, so the span has no licensed referent or Time filler.
Day-of-year dating in a fictional calendar ("On day 60 of Year 1"): (Day n) is defined as a calendar day inside a month/date, not a day ordinal within a year.

Quantity-per-time-unit rate on an event's object ("about twelve feathers per morning"): TimesPer counts occurrences and the compound <unit>_per_<unit> Measure form is defined for a bearer's own magnitude, so the "twelve per morning" binding has no single licensed carrier.
notes: Roles, compound decomposition (sky_cat/cliff_spire), group + per-member distribution handling, and the reified-state route for "were visible" all follow the instruction set; the weak points are concentrated in the temporal encoding. Approximated counts were routed to CardinalityPhrase with non-lexicon strings ("about four"), which no seeded phrase rule can map back to a bound.
